  "summary": "The complaint describes an intermittent wiring short that interrupted the high-voltage battery coolant pump; the dealer reproduced the fault by moving the wiring and restored pump operation through wiring repair. None of the candidate recalls addresses this failure, and the earlier complaints returned do not establish a matching pattern. Review the repair documentation for the wiring damage mechanism and potential effect on battery cooling; overheating, fire, or injury was not reported."
